exercises.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
how_to: Set the bench to a 30-45 degree incline and lie back with feet planted.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width and unrack it.
Lower the bar to your upper chest with control.
Press the bar back up until your arms are extended.

exercises.name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
how_to: Secure your legs and lie back on the decline bench.
Grip the bar just wider than shoulder-width and unrack it.
Lower the bar to your lower chest.
Press it back up until your arms lock out.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
how_to: Lie flat on the bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Start with the dumbbells at chest level, elbows bent.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are extended.
Lower them back down with control.

exercises.name: Decline Dumbbell Press
how_to: Secure your legs and lie back on the decline bench.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand at lower-chest level.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms extend.
Lower them back down slowly.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
how_to: Set the bench to a low incline and lie back with a dumbbell in each hand.
Extend your arms above your chest with a slight elbow bend.
Open your arms in a wide arc until you feel a chest stretch.
Bring the dumbbells back together over your chest.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover (High To Low)
how_to: Set both pulleys high and grab a handle in each hand.
Step forward with a slight forward lean and soft elbows.
Pull the handles down and across to meet in front of your hips.
Return to the start under control.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover (Low To High)
how_to: Set both pulleys low and grab a handle in each hand.
Step forward with a slight lean and soft elbows.
Sweep the handles up and together in front of your face.
Lower them back down with control.

exercises.name: Pec Deck
how_to: Sit with your back flat against the pad and grip the handles.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Squeeze the handles together in front of your chest.
Slowly let them return to the stretched position.

exercises.name: Chest Press Machine
how_to: Adjust the seat so the handles align with your mid-chest.
Grip the handles and keep your back against the pad.
Press the handles forward until your arms extend.
Return slowly to the starting position.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Ups
how_to: Place your hands on a bench slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Step your feet back into a straight plank position.
Lower your chest toward the bench by bending your elbows.
Push back up until your arms are extended.

exercises.name: Decline Push-Ups
how_to: Place your feet on a bench and hands on the floor.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Press back up until your arms extend.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Ups
how_to: Get into a plank with your hands together forming a diamond shape.
Keep your body in a straight line and elbows tucked.
Lower your chest toward your hands.
Push back up until your arms are fully extended.

exercises.name: Svend Press
how_to: Press two weight plates together between your palms at chest level.
Squeeze the plates hard to engage your chest.
Press the plates straight out until your arms extend.
Pull them back to your chest under control.

exercises.name: Landmine Press
how_to: Hold the end of the landmine bar at shoulder height.
Stand in a staggered stance with your core braced.
Press the bar up and slightly forward until your arm extends.
Lower it back to your shoulder with control.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
how_to: Hold two dumbbells in front of your shoulders, palms facing you.
Press up while rotating your palms to face forward.
Extend fully overhead.
Reverse the motion back to the start.

exercises.name: Push Press
how_to: Hold the bar at your front shoulders with an overhand grip.
Dip slightly by bending your knees.
Drive up explosively and press the bar overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulders with control.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
how_to: Adjust the seat so the handles sit at shoulder height.
Grip the handles and keep your back against the pad.
Press the handles overhead until your arms extend.
Lower them back down slowly.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raises
how_to: Set a low pulley and grab the handle with the outside hand.
Stand side-on to the machine with a slight elbow bend.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower it back down with control.

exercises.name: Front Raises
how_to: Hold a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and brace your core.
Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height in front of you.
Lower them back down slowly.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly (Dumbbell)
how_to: Hinge forward at the hips holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Let the dumbbells hang with a slight elbow bend.
Raise your arms out to the sides, squeezing your rear delts.
Lower them back down with control.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly (Machine)
how_to: Sit facing the pad and grip the handles with arms extended.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the handles out and back, squeezing your rear delts.
Return to the start under control.

exercises.name: Upright Rows
how_to: Hold the bar with an overhand grip in front of your thighs.
Keep the bar close to your body.
Pull it up toward your chin, leading with your elbows.
Lower it back down with control.

exercises.name: Barbell Shrugs
how_to: Hold the bar in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and core braced.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Lower them back down slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shrugs
how_to: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep your arms straight and shoulders relaxed.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Lower them back down under control.

exercises.name: Cuban Press
how_to: Hold light dumbbells with elbows bent and raised to shoulder height.
Externally rotate your forearms up until they point to the ceiling.
Press the dumbbells overhead.
Reverse each step back to the start.

exercises.name: Bradford Press
how_to: Hold the bar at your front shoulders with an overhand grip.
Press up just high enough to clear your head.
Lower the bar behind your head to neck level.
Press back up and return it to the front.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
how_to: Lie on the bench and grip the bar about shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your chest.
Lower it to your lower chest, keeping elbows tucked.
Press the bar back up until your arms extend.

exercises.name: Triceps Dips
how_to: Grip the parallel bars and support yourself with arms extended.
Keep your torso fairly upright to target the triceps.
Lower your body by bending your elbows to about 90 degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension (Dumbbell)
how_to: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Keep your elbows close to your head.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms back up to the top.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension (Cable)
how_to: Set a rope on a high or low pulley and face away from the machine.
Hold the rope overhead with elbows bent.
Extend your arms forward and up until they lock out.
Return under control to the stretched position.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown (Bar)
how_to: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and grip it overhand.
Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are fully extended.
Let it rise back up under control.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown (Rope)
how_to: Attach a rope to a high pulley and grip both ends.
Keep your elbows pinned at your sides.
Push down and spread the rope ends apart at the bottom.
Return under control to the start.

exercises.name: Triceps Kickbacks
how_to: Hinge forward with a dumbbell in each hand and elbows raised.
Keep your upper arms parallel to the floor.
Extend your forearms back until your arms are straight.
Return to the bent position with control.

exercises.name: Bench Dips
how_to: Sit on the edge of a bench and grip it beside your hips.
Slide your hips off the bench with legs extended forward.
Lower your body by bending your elbows to about 90 degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: JM Press
how_to: Lie on the bench and hold the bar with a close grip over your chest.
Lower the bar toward your upper chest and neck, keeping elbows forward.
Stop when your forearms nearly touch your biceps.
Press the bar back up until your arms extend.

exercises.name: Chin-Ups
how_to: Grip the bar with an underhand grip about shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms extended and core braced.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself back down with control.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Pull-Ups
how_to: Grip the bar overhand, wider than shoulder-width.
Hang with your arms extended and shoulders engaged.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself back down slowly.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Ups
how_to: Grip parallel handles with your palms facing each other.
Hang with your arms extended and core tight.
Pull yourself up until your chin reaches the handles.
Lower back down under control.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Close Grip)
how_to: Attach a close-grip handle and sit with your thighs secured.
Grip the handle and lean back slightly.
Pull the handle to your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Let it rise back up under control.

exercises.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
how_to: Hold the bar with an overhand grip and hinge forward at the hips.
Keep your back flat and knees slightly bent.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower it back down with control.

exercises.name: Pendlay Row
how_to: Set your torso parallel to the floor with the bar on the ground.
Grip the bar overhand just wider than shoulder-width.
Explosively pull the bar to your lower chest.
Return it to the floor and reset each rep.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Row
how_to: Place one knee and hand on a bench with the other foot planted.
Hold a dumbbell in the free hand, arm extended.
Pull the dumbbell to your hip, driving your elbow back.
Lower it back down with control.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
how_to: Set the bench to a low incline and lie chest-down on it.
Let a dumbbell hang in each hand below your shoulders.
Row the dumbbells up to your sides, squeezing your back.
Lower them back down under control.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row
how_to: Straddle the loaded bar and attach a close-grip handle.
Hinge forward with a flat back and slight knee bend.
Pull the handle to your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower it back down with control.

exercises.name: Machine Row
how_to: Sit with your chest against the pad and grip the handles.
Keep your back straight and core braced.
Pull the handles toward you, driving your elbows back.
Return to the start under control.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
how_to: Set a bar at waist height and hang underneath it.
Grip it overhand and keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest up to the bar, squeezing your back.
Lower yourself back down with control.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
how_to: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and grip it overhand.
Stand back with a slight hip hinge and arms extended.
Pull the bar down to your thighs, keeping your arms straight.
Let it rise back up under control.

exercises.name: Deadlift
how_to: Stand with mid-foot under the bar and grip it just outside your knees.
Set a flat back, chest up, and brace your core.
Drive through your legs and stand up, keeping the bar close.
Return the bar to the floor with control.

exercises.name: Rack Pulls
how_to: Set the bar on rack pins at knee height.
Grip the bar overhand with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward and stand up to lockout.
Lower the bar back to the pins under control.

exercises.name: Meadows Row
how_to: Stand perpendicular to a landmine bar and grip its end overhand.
Hinge forward with a flat back, staggered stance.
Row the bar up toward your hip, driving your elbow high.
Lower it back down with control.

exercises.name: Renegade Row
how_to: Start in a plank gripping a dumbbell in each hand.
Keep your hips square and core tight.
Row one dumbbell to your side while balancing on the other.
Lower it and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
how_to: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms forward.
Keep your elbows tucked against your torso.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Lower them back down with control.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
how_to: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip, palms facing in.
Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
Curl the dumbbells up while keeping your palms facing inward.
Lower them back down under control.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
how_to: Set the bench to an incline and lie back with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down, palms forward.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Lower them back down for a full stretch.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
how_to: Rest the backs of your upper arms on the preacher pad.
Hold the bar with an underhand grip, arms extended.
Curl the weight up toward your shoulders.
Lower it back down slowly to full extension.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
how_to: Sit and brace your working elbow against your inner thigh.
Hold a dumbbell with your arm extended.
Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Lower it back down with control.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
how_to: Attach a bar to a low pulley and grip it underhand.
Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower it back down under constant tension.

exercises.name: Spider Curl
how_to: Lie chest-down on an inclined bench with your arms hanging down.
Hold the weight with an underhand grip.
Curl it up toward your shoulders, keeping your upper arms still.
Lower it back down slowly.

exercises.name: Zottman Curl
how_to: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells up to your shoulders.
Rotate your palms to face down at the top.
Lower the dumbbells slowly, then rotate back at the bottom.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl
how_to: Hold the bar with an overhand grip in front of your thighs.
Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower it back down with control.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
how_to: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip.
Keep your elbow tucked at your side.
Curl one dumbbell across your body toward the opposite shoulder.
Lower it and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Wrist Curls
how_to: Rest your forearms on your thighs with your wrists past your knees.
Hold the weight with an underhand grip, palms up.
Curl your wrists up, letting the weight roll to your fingertips first.
Lower it back down with control.

exercises.name: Reverse Wrist Curls
how_to: Rest your forearms on your thighs with your wrists past your knees.
Hold the weight with an overhand grip, palms down.
Extend your wrists up as far as you can.
Lower them back down slowly.

exercises.name: Farmer's Carry
how_to: Pick up a heavy weight in each hand and stand tall.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders back.
Walk forward with short, controlled steps.
Set the weights down safely at the end.

exercises.name: Dead Hang
how_to: Grip the bar overhand about shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms fully extended and feet off the floor.
Keep your shoulders slightly engaged.
Hold for time, then lower yourself down safely.

exercises.name: Plate Pinches
how_to: Stack two plates smooth-side out and pinch them with your fingers.
Lift the plates off the ground and stand tall.
Hold them for time using only your fingers and thumb.
Lower them down safely.

exercises.name: Hand Gripper
how_to: Hold the gripper in one hand with the handle across your palm.
Squeeze the handles together as far as you can.
Hold briefly at full closure.
Release slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: Wrist Roller
how_to: Hold the roller out in front of you at shoulder height.
Keep your arms extended and core braced.
Roll the weight up by turning the bar hand over hand.
Reverse the motion to lower it back down.
